exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Her normal kitchen request becomes one sharper familiar call without becoming anger.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: He answers, fails to move, then visibly abandons the game and commits to innocent arrival.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Controller state changes from active after the first request to abandoned after the second.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: Automatic non-movement becomes immediate physical compliance.
exploration_routes.payoff: He arrives asking what happened as though the first request never existed.
